g.text: Left: 10-100%, percentile bootstrap that resamples the 65 source genomes and keeps their replicates together (10,000 resamples). At 5%, 0 of 65 genomes: upper limit of the two-sided exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval, 5.5%.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Intervals do not account for relatedness among source genomes. The two series use different replicate sets. Right: the last column is the UAA rule plus the tRNA-Tyr gate and locus audit (PREREG 2.3) on known positives; it does not test

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: the novelty or replication parts of PREREG 3. The UAA rule was set with all lineages in view. False Tyr with thresholds from the other phyla (29 held-out phyla): 0 of 340, upper bound 1.1%. Sources: results/gate2, results/posthoc2 [P].
